outcome: Attendance at postpartum blood pressure follow-up visit
cohort: Postpartum women who had a hypertensive disorder of pregnancy (n=378)
finding: Women who attended a postpartum blood pressure visit were more likely to have had significant hypertensive disease or a cesarean delivery, while Non-Hispanic Black women had the lowest rate of follow-up.
mod_finding: Women who underwent a cesarean delivery were more likely to attend a postpartum blood pressure follow-up visit.
